facts.image: red line = trace, yellow dot = click; panels: close-up, slice 0, slice 19

text: This trace was followed across 20 slices and stays on the clicked layer, and it is much closer than before the fix, improving from 19.2% within 5 voxels and a median distance of 16.0 voxels to 49.4% within 5 voxels and a median distance of 5.1 voxels. It cannot be fully trusted because only 23.8% is within 2 voxels, so much remains more than 5 voxels away. It is weakest away from the yellow dot, where the red line in the close-up and in slice 0 and slice 19 views drifts between bright layers. A person should check the red line against the bright sheet in those views, especially where layers merge or split, before using it for reading.
